story.title: Zee Sues Nykaa in Delhi HC Over Copyrighted Songs Used in Instagram Reels Ads Without Permission
story.summary: Zee Entertainment has filed a lawsuit against beauty e-commerce platform Nykaa in the Delhi High Court, alleging that Nykaa used Zee's copyrighted songs in Instagram Reels advertising campaigns without obtaining licences or paying royalties, and seeking Rs 2 crore in damages. The case could set a landmark precedent for how Indian brands are required to clear music rights before using short-form video content for commercial promotion on social media platforms. Legal experts say the outcome may reshape compliance practices across India's digital advertising industry.
